func (*Plugin) Name() string

func (*mediaTool) Description() string

func (*mediaTool) Name() string

func (*mediaTool) ParametersSchema() json.RawMessage

func (*mediaTool) Scheduling(wire.ToolCall) abi.Scheduling

func (l *Library) ListArtifacts(ctx context.Context, sourceURI string, after, highWater uint64) (storage.ArtifactIndexPage, error)

func (l *Library) Original(ctx context.Context, uri string) (storage.ArtifactInfo, []byte, error)

func (l *Library) ReadDerivative(ctx context.Context, manifestURI string) (Manifest, []byte, error)

func (l *Library) ReadManifest(ctx context.Context, uri string) (Manifest, error)

func (l *Library) ReadReceipt(ctx context.Context, uri string) (Receipt, error)

func (l *Library) ReadSelection(ctx context.Context, uri string) (Selection, error)

func (l *Library) Receipts(ctx context.Context, selectionID string, after, highWater uint64) (storage.ArtifactIndexPage, error)

func (l *Library) Selections(ctx context.Context, after, highWater uint64) (storage.ArtifactIndexPage, error)

func (l *Library) Sources(ctx context.Context, after, highWater uint64) (storage.ArtifactIndexPage, error)

func (p *Plugin) CleanupComplete() bool

func (p *Plugin) Close(ctx context.Context) error

func (p *Plugin) Finalize(_ context.Context, late core.LateContext) ([]abi.Tool, error)

func (p *Plugin) OnRunEnd(ctx context.Context, r abi.RuntimeContext, _ error) error

func (p *Plugin) OnRunStart(ctx context.Context, r abi.RuntimeContext) error

func (p *Plugin) Register(_ context.Context, r *core.Registrar) error

func (p *Plugin) Tool() abi.Tool

func (p *Plugin) WrapModel(ctx context.Context, r abi.RuntimeContext, request abi.ModelRequest, emit func(wire.StreamChunk) error, next abi.ModelFunc) error

func (t *mediaTool) DescribeEffect(call wire.ToolCall) abi.Effect

func (t *mediaTool) Execute(ctx context.Context, e abi.ToolExecutionContext, call wire.ToolCall) (wire.ToolResult, error)

func (t *mediaTool) IsReadOnly(call wire.ToolCall) bool

func New(ctx context.Context, config Config) (*Plugin, error)

func NewLibrary(ctx context.Context, repository Storage, owner, id string) (*Library, error)

type Config struct {
	Repository                   Storage
	Owner, SessionID, Cwd, Route string
	Guard                        *security.Guard
	ImageCapable                 bool
	ProviderID, ModelID          string
	Processor                    *nativemedia.Processor

	SelectedInputURIs []string
	InputsOnly        bool
}

type Library struct {
}

type Manifest struct {
	Version    int                `json:"version"`
	Source     wire.Reference     `json:"source"`
	Artifact   wire.Reference     `json:"artifact"`
	Output     nativemedia.Output `json:"output"`
	Processing string             `json:"processing"`
}

type Plugin struct {
}

type Receipt struct {
	Version     int       `json:"version"`
	SelectionID string    `json:"selection_id"`
	RunID       string    `json:"run_id"`
	State       string    `json:"state"`
	Time        time.Time `json:"time"`
	ProviderID  string    `json:"provider_id,omitempty"`
	ModelID     string    `json:"model_id,omitempty"`
	Processing  string    `json:"processing"`
}

type Selection struct {
	ID         string     `json:"id"`
	RunID      string     `json:"run_id"`
	CallID     string     `json:"call_id"`
	Route      string     `json:"route"`
	Reason     string     `json:"reason"`
	Manifests  []Manifest `json:"manifests"`
	Processing string     `json:"processing"`
}

type Storage interface {
	storage.Journal
	storage.ArtifactReader
	storage.References
}
